items.summary: Creatine helped middle-aged adults gain muscle and strength even without a structured workout program in a new 12-week study. items.title: Cannabis users were twice as likely to commit violence, review finds
items.summary: A review of more than 265,000 people found that cannabis use was associated with higher rates of both committing violence and becoming a victim of it. The researchers say the link is significant but does not prove cannabis itself is the cause.

items.title: Swiss glaciers suffer 'disastrous' year of ice loss, threatening water supplies
items.summary: Scientists say such rapid melting is no longer surprising given the pace of climate change.
